```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.DataFrame({
    "epoch": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "accuracy": [0.55, 0.68, 0.76, 0.82, 0.87]
})

data
```

```{python}
plt.plot(data["epoch"], data["accuracy"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Epoch")
plt.ylabel("Accuracy")
plt.title("Training Accuracy")
plt.grid()
plt.show()
```
